function.name: set_lights_power
function.description: Turn the lights in a room on or off. If no room is given, the room the user is currently in is used.

room.description: The room to act on. 'whole_house' means every room; 'current_room' means the room the user is in right now. Defaults to 'current_room'.

power.description: Whether to turn the lights on or off.

function.name: set_lights_brightness
function.description: Set the brightness of the lights in a room as a percentage. If no room is given, the room the user is currently in is used.

room.description: The room to act on. 'whole_house' means every room; 'current_room' means the room the user is in right now. Defaults to 'current_room'.

function.name: set_lights_color
function.description: Set the colour of the lights in a room. If no room is given, the room the user is currently in is used.

room.description: The room to act on. 'whole_house' means every room; 'current_room' means the room the user is in right now. Defaults to 'current_room'.

function.name: control_vacuum
function.description: Control the robot vacuum: start cleaning, stop, or send it back to its dock. When starting, a room can optionally be given; if none is given the whole house is cleaned.

action.description: 'start' begins cleaning, 'stop' stops it, 'dock' sends it back to its dock.

room.description: Only used with action 'start'. The room to clean; 'current_room' means the room the user is in right now. Omit to clean the whole house.

function.name: set_plug_power
function.description: Switch the smart plug on or off.

power.description: Whether to switch the plug on or off.
